SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL P
File No S. B. REGIS 1909
No. S. b. D. 1/40
Date January 11, 1940

Subject Leaflets announcing a series of lectures on prophecies of the Bible.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by

Forwarded herewith are specimens of a leaf-
let in Russian announcing a series of public lectures
at 69 Wayside Road, the first of which will be held at
7.45 p.m. on 11-1-40. Admission is free and open to
all members of the public.

It appears from the leaflet that the lectures
will be devoted to subjects relating to "theology, study of
the Bible, psychology, atheism and various prophecies con-
tained in the Bible". The Bible, it is stated, contains
the solutions of political and theological problems an-
nounced many thousands of years ago.

A similar announcement appeared in the lo-
cal Russian press to-day, in which it is stated that
lectures of the same kind will be held at 686 Avenue
Joffre. At the latter address is located a church of
Seventh Day Adventists, and the residence of Mr. K.D.
Karallashili, prominent member of the religious commu-
mity in question.

日期 1940年1月11日

主题：宣布一系列关于《圣经》预言讲座的传单。

由警探长普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）制作。转呈者

兹随函附上俄文传单样本，该传单宣布将在韦赛德路（Wayside Road）69号举行一系列公开讲座，首场讲座将于1940年1月11日晚上7点45分举行。免费入场，向所有公众开放。

从传单内容来看，讲座将致力于探讨与“神学、《圣经》研究、心理学、无神论以及《圣经》中包含的各种预言”有关的主题。据称，《圣经》包含了几千年前就已宣告的政治和神学问题的解决方案。

今日当地俄文报刊上刊登了一则类似公告，其中声明同类讲座将在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）686号举行。该地址设有一座基督复临安息日会教堂，也是上述宗教团体知名成员K.D. Karallashili先生（音译）的住所。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.........
Section 1, Special Branch Stable/
REPORT
Date May 2, 1938

Subject Meeting at the Cossacks' Union, 1292 Avenue Edward VII, on 1-5-38.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford

Over 100 persons attended the meeting which was
held under the auspices of the " Shanghai Section for Combating
Atheism" between 8 p.m. and 10.30 p.m. on May 1, 1938 in the
premises of the Cossacks' Union, 1292 Avenue Edward VII, House 1.
The programme of the meeting included addresses on
the following subjects:-

1. Russian Orthodox Faith
as one of the foundations
of the national Russia...... by Mr. I.V.ussi-Mussienko

2. Disseminators of spiri-
tual poison................ by Mr. S.V.Amelevsky.

3. Foundations of Faith and
the origin of atheism....... by Father M.Medvedeff.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 2 MAY 1938）

In conclusion it was announced that representatives
of various Russian religious sects in Shanghai who were asked
to take part in the dicussions on two previously announced sub-
jects, had declined the invitation on various pretexts, and
that another attempt will be made to secure their participation
in a debate to be arranged in the near future.

The meeting was attended by Bishop Juvenalius of
the Russian Orthodox Mission in China.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

主题：1938年5月1日在爱德华七世大道（Avenue Edward VII）1292号哥萨克联盟举行的会议。

由警探长普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）制作。由C. Crawford转呈

1938年5月1日晚上8点至10点30分，在爱德华七世大道1292号1号的哥萨克联盟场所内，在“上海反无神论分部”的主持下举行了一次会议，出席人数超过100人。会议议程包括以下主题的演讲：-

1. 俄罗斯东正教信仰

2. 精神毒药的
传播者................由 S.V.Amelevsky 先生主讲。

3. 信仰的基础和
无神论的起源.......由 M.Medvedeff 神父主讲。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科 1938年5月2日）

最后宣布，曾受邀就此前公布的两个主题参与讨论的上海各俄罗斯宗教派别代表，以各种借口拒绝了邀请，并将再次尝试争取他们参与近期安排的辩论。

REPORT
Date April 30, 19 38
Subject Meeting at the Cossacks' Union, 1292 Avenue Edward VII, on
1.5.38.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by C. Gandon D.S.

The so-called "Shanghai Section for Combating Atheism"
announced in the local Russian press that at 7.30 p.m. on
May 1 a series of lectures on religious subjects will be held
by members of the Section in the premises of the Cossacks'
Union, 1292 Avenue Edward VII, House 1. It is also announced
that leaders of various religious sects in Shanghai are
invited to participate in the discussions which will follow
the lectures, the subjects selected for these discussions being
1) Baptism and
2) Worshipping Icons.
During the past three months several lectures of this
type were held by the same group at 832 Weihaiwei Road -
premises occupied by the "All-Russia Fascist Party." These
lectures attracted a very small audience and were conducted
in an orderly manner.
With regard to the proposed discussions which constitute
a departure from previous practices, it is reported that
during the course of religious meetings held under the
auspices of the local branch of the 7th Day Adventist Church
reference to political matters are frequently made, the
general trend of which aroused much adverse comment on the
part of many Russians who do not belong to this particular
church. It is reported that the invitation to participate
in the proposed discussions has in view leaders of the 7th
Day Adventist Church and that if the latter accept the
challenge, the discussions may touch upon matters of a
political nature.

（印：SHANGHAI SPECIAL BRANCH 30 APR. 1938 mB）
D.S.I. Gandon
C. 2/5
S.I.

主题：1938年5月1日在爱德华七世大道（Avenue Edward VII）1292号哥萨克联盟举行的会议。
由警探长普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）制作，由 C. Gandon D.S. 转呈

所谓的“上海反无神论分部”在当地俄文报刊上宣布，将于5月1日晚上7点30分，由该分部成员在爱德华七世大道1292号1号的哥萨克联盟场所内举行一系列宗教主题讲座。同时还宣布，邀请上海各宗教派别的领袖参加讲座后的讨论，选定的讨论主题为
1) 洗礼 和
2) 圣像崇拜。
在过去三个月里，同一群体在威海卫路（Weihaiwei Road）832号——即“全俄法西斯党”所占用的场所——举行过几次此类讲座。这些讲座听众寥寥，但进行得井然有序。
关于拟议中的讨论（这与以往做法有所不同），据报道，在当地基督复临安息日会分部主持的宗教会议过程中，经常提及政治事务，其总体倾向引起了众多不属于该特定教会的俄罗斯人的强烈负面评论。据报道，邀请参与拟议讨论的对象包括基督复临安息日会的领袖，如果后者接受挑战，讨论可能会触及具有政治性质的事项。

（印：上海特务科 1938年4月30日 mB）

REPORT
Date October 31, 1930.

Subject (in full) Handbill emanating from Soviet sources enclosed in
Russian newspapers of October 31, 1930.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I.Moore.

Sir,
The attached handbill in the Soviet orthography is enclosed
in to-days Russian newspapers. The handbill announces a series
of religious meetings to be held in the Settlement at 35, Range
Road, on Sundays, Mondays and Wednesdays, and in the French
Concession at 70, Route Vallon on Sundays, Tuesdays and Thursdays,
when religious subjects touching on "The End of the World" will
be discussed. The three cardinal questions to be treated Are:-
1. Have the Bible's prophetic powers been verified?
2. How will the world's struggle finish, and what will be
the end of the world's present nightmare?
3. The world's conflict between Capital and Labour. The
time when this event will materialise is clearly given
in the Bible.
The handbill is not signed by any person or society, nor is
any address given by those responsible for the issue of it.

D.S.I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

S2, For attention. Has all
this any special significance?

先生，
所附采用苏维埃拼写法的传单夹在今日的俄文报纸中。该传单宣布将于周日、周一和周三在租界兰路（Range Road）35号，以及周日、周二和周四在法租界瓦隆路（Route Vallon）70号举行一系列宗教集会，届时将讨论涉及“世界末日”的宗教主题。将要处理的三个核心问题是：-
1. 《圣经》的预言能力是否得到验证？

该传单没有任何个人或社团署名，发行负责人也未提供地址。

Пророки Божіи предсказывали, что в

布道

《圣经》一书清晰而令人信服地告诉
人类，世纪末即将来临，
并且它指出了许多征
兆，从而使人们有机会为这
非凡的日子做好准备。
上帝的先知们预言，在
“最后的日子”或“时代的终结”，
发明和科学成就的时代、财富
积累以及资本与劳动之间斗争的时代、犯罪
狂欢、道德残酷和不道德娱乐的时代、家庭
混乱、普遍的**不信**、灾难
和痛苦的洪流以及“狂怒的民族”中流淌的鲜血
将会到来。
以上仅列举了一些杰出的预言，它们明确地
